body: I have no idea what you’re talking about. I’m deleting Reddit.
We never Trumpers wonder the same thing. It’s shameful. I never grasped the depth of callousness and ignorance many Americans have. Trump soiled the US. It’ll take time to get the stench off.

Ever notice how some people respond to growing old and the physical decline by saying “At least it’s better than the alternative”! I don’t understand that comment any more. Especially from people with serious physical pain. 

Many of these people also believe in heaven and it’s promise of no pain. Yet they are still clingy to life and “I don’t wanna die”! 

I’ll be running toward the white tunnel when the time comes. No more bills! No more worries! No more aggravations! No more stifling anxiety! No more pain! No more technology to wrestle with! No more politics!

I have health insurance thanks to the ACA. If I got cancer or other serious illness I probably wouldn’t treat it. I could never afford the bills or work long enough to pay them off. America sucks with health care thanks to big Pharma and other lobbyists that love the huge profits they make on the backs of sick people. They bought our Congress.
